basic_info.description: Fabulous remodeled Craftsman home on impressive corner lot, steps to West Portal Village! Delightful garden entrance w/nice variety of mature succulents & palms leads to an enclosed vestibule & into a gracious foyer w/open-banister staircase. Magnificent formal living rm w/tray ceiling boasts a majestic fireplace w/craftsman brick surround, expansive mantel, built-in bookcases w/leaded-glass doors, hardwood floors & picture window w/pretty outlooks to neighboring St. Francis Wood homes. Banquet-size formal dining rm w/open-beam ceiling, period wall paneling, stationary French doors & stunning divided-light window w/views to the garden! Splendid gourmet kitchen w/breakfast bar showcases all Bosch stainless-steel appliances, incl a five-burner gas range, Carrara quartz counters w/porcelain tile backsplash, snazzy custom cabinets, convenient pantry & direct access to the backyard. Exquisite open-banister staircase w/period stained-glass window ascends to the upper level w/3BR & 2BA + laundry on same floor. Grand master suite features cedar-lined closets & a stylish en-suite bath w/marble-top vanity sink, cast-iron tub & walk-in shower. Lower level enjoys an outstanding guest quarters/in-law w/BR, BA, Kit, Family Rm & Laundry Rm. Landscaped backyard w/flagstone patio & sweeping lawn!
